confirm.title: Analyze the song again?
confirm.body: This redoes the shots. Each chosen photo (and the pinned ones) moves to the new shot at the same moment; a few may be left out. Undo history and hand-picked transitions are cleared. Only do this if you changed the lyrics or the MP3.

noPeople.title: Suggest without choosing people?
noPeople.body: You haven't picked anyone in “Who's in them”: all photos from those dates will be used.

suggest.checking: Checking which photos have been analyzed…

noGpu.title: Suggest without {{name}}?
noGpu.pending_one: {{name}} is off and {{pending}} of the {{pool}} candidate photos hasn't been analyzed on the GPU.
noGpu.pending_other: {{name}} is off and {{pending}} of the {{pool}} candidate photos haven't been analyzed on the GPU.
noGpu.risk: Those photos may show up without the sensitive photo warning (and “Avoid” won't filter them out), and their quality (eyes, smile, focus) won't count. If you turn on {{name}}, they're analyzed automatically when you suggest.

confirm.title: Lock the project?
confirm.body: It's saved just as it is: no photos, framing, settings, lyrics or song can be changed (and the project can't be deleted). You can still watch and make videos, and create a new version to keep going from it. You can unlock it later.

confirm.title: Unlock the project?
confirm.body: It can be changed again. If you want to keep this version as it is, better create a new version and change that one.

confirm.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
confirm.body: This deletes the project, its song and its videos from Slidesong. Your Immich photos aren't touched. This can't be undone.
